title: The Junction - EXIT 2
description: A creative tech modpack built around Create for building, automation, railways, storage, and fun with friends.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8eb54c2accd5858302f96209f30e1899b6a651ce.png)

**Now on 1.21.1**

Welcome to The Junction: EXIT 2, a modpack where creativity comes first.

This pack is built for players who want to create without limits. Design huge factories, build detailed towns, run railway networks across your world, automate everything you can, and bring your ideas to life with a strong mix of tech, engineering, storage, and decoration mods.

Using Create, you can build moving machines, functional trains, hidden doors, elevators, farms, and mechanical systems that make your world feel alive.

On top of that, the pack includes plenty of mods for building, decorating, mining, farming, tools, armor, and progression, giving you freedom to play the way you want.

Upgrade your world with
Better building
Better automation
Better storage
Better machinery
Better farming
Better mining
Better railways
Better gear

Whether you are playing alone or with friends, The Junction: EXIT 2 is about making something awesome and enjoying every part of the process.

Important
Increase allocated RAM before launching
Do not update Oculus

Most importantly:
Have fun.
